title: Mirabel and the Cover
author: Xanthe Marchetti
blurb: Casper Villalobos, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
